publishedfiledetails.title: Gardeneer Hat (Farming helper)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
This is a mod designed for clients to improve the farming experience of everyone, it provides you with the same features of the Premier Gardeneer Hat and some other features.

Originally it was made to grant players access to the 'Plant Registry' and the 'Nutrient Vision' of the Premier Gardeneer Hat via two buttons in your HUD only, but now it also includes other features which will become enabled with the nutrient vision to make farming easier for everyone:

[h1]Available Features:[/h1]

[h1]Colored Crops[/h1]

Crops start changing their colour if they detect any source of stress:

[img=https://i.imgur.com/brfxjw2.png]
(Upper in 100% sanity, lower in 0% sanity)

Color meaning from left to right:
[table]
	[tr]
		[th]Red[/th]
		[th]Killjoy[/th]
		[th]Killjoys do bother your nearby crops and increase their stress.
Killjoys include Weeds, Spoiled Plants, or Garden Detritus.
Try to get rid of them if they spawn in your crops farm.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Pink[/th]
		[th]Harmless Killjoy[/th]
		[th]A killjoy which does not bother any of your nearby crops yet.
Killjoys include Weeds, Spoiled Plants, or Garden Detritus.
Despite the fact that they don't bother your plants yet it might be useful or not to get rid of them.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Yellow[/th]
		[th]Tendable[/th]
		[th]This crop has not been attended yet during this growth stage.
Crops can be attended to by talking to them or by using an item which attends to nearby plants (e.g. One-Man Band, Beefalo Horn, Shell Bells, etc.)[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Blue[/th]
		[th]Thirsty[/th]
		[th]There's no water left in the ground.
Water your farm with a Watering Can.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Green[/th]
		[th]Hungry[/th]
		[th]There are not enough nutrients available in the ground.
Fertilize your Farm Plot with the respective required nutrients.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Cyan[/th]
		[th]Alone[/th]
		[th]There are less than 3 plants of the same kind nearby.
Plant more crops of the same kind nearby to satisfy its requirements.
Only visible during the seed stage.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]White[/th]
		[th]Tendable & Alone[/th]
		[th]Combines the effects of Tendable & Alone.
Talk to this crop & plant more crops of the same kind nearby.
Only visible during the seed stage.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Black[/th]
		[th]Parent[/th]
		[th]This Plant is already fully grown but harvesting it will increase the stress of certain nearby plant(s) since this plant is one of only three other family plants which satisfies its requirements for a family.
Only visible if harvestable.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]None[/th]
		[th]Happy[/th]
		[th]No stress detected.
Note that your crop can still be bothered by nearby killjoys or the lack of a family.[/th]
	[/tr]
[/table]

[h1]Ground Analyzer[/h1]

Walking above a Farm plot creates a table which shows you the currently available nutrients in the soil & a statistic about how many nutrients will be consumed by the plants:

[table]
	[tr]
		[th]Balance[/th]
		[th]Shows the amount of nutrients plants do consume or produce with each growth stage. These numbers are reduced by 50% if the current season is not one of the plant's favorite seasons since plants do grow 50% slower in that case.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Total[/th]
		[th]Shows the total amount of consumed or produced nutrients if every plant reaches their full size.[/th]
	[/tr]
	[tr]
		[th]Available[/th]
		[th]An estimation of the currently available nutrients in the soil (it is inaccurate because you can't get better values from the soil as a client).[/th]
	[/tr]
[/table]

Holding any fertilizer or plant seeds will show you how it will affect your farm if applied/planted.

[h1]Crop Analyzer[/h1]

Examining a farm plant via your Force Inspect button shows you some information about it, including all the available stress sources for that plant and the meaning of the current colour.

[h1]Others[/h1]

Researched Plants:
[list]
[*] All: Unlocks available plants & fertilizers in your Plant Registry (This will not affect your real data and you won't be able to research any farm plants, weeds or fertilizers while this option is active)
[*] Seeds Only: Unlocks only the required research to make crop seeds display the name of the crop.
[/list]



Update 1.5:
[list]
[*] Colour of harmless Killjoys is now bit less obvious
[*] Fixed a bug causing crops not be marked as Parent
[*] Improved the required water guesser a bit (now also includes naturally drained water)
[*] Added Simplyfied Chinese to the languages (Translated by 琪莎猫)
[/list]

This mod is able to support different languages, I can implement any language you want into the mod if you send me a translated version of the string files.

[h1]Notes[/h1]

Incompatible with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2319370282]Remove Purple Overlay[/url] mod.

publishedfiledetails.title: Insight (Show Me+)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Thank you for 1 million subscribers![/h1]
I never expected this many users. Thank you for your support!

[h1]Background Information[/h1]
Inspired by Show Me.
Because I like to know everything about everything. Show me was nice, but it was inaccurate/weird for some things and just didn't have what I was looking for.
This was coded from scratch, and I originally made it for DS. I ported it over!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2081254154][b]Click for DS Version[/b][/url]

[h1]Details[/h1]
Whereas some mods provide information only on inspection, this provides a tooltip with various information on mouse over. Information is cached for items in your active area (Klei has this set to about 2 screens length) and seeks to find a balance between efficiency and convenience.

[h3]Server/Client Configuration[/h3]
Clients and servers share most of the options, with some being exclusive to the client. By default, [u]undefined[/u] options are chosen which means the client can choose what they want. Otherwise, the server has authority. 

Server Configuration: [u]Main Menu -> Host Game[/u] -> Mods -> Server Mods -> Insight -> Configure Mod
Client Configuration: [u]Main Menu -> Mods[/u] -> Server Mods -> Insight -> Configure Mod

[i]A lot of this stuff is controlled in the mod configuration. In general, if it has to do with HOW the information is displayed, it's a client setting. If it has to do with the information itself, it's a server setting.[/i]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b][u]Controller Support[/u][/b]
[*]Farm Information
[*]Text coloring
[*]Icon Mode
[*]Attack ranges
[*]Health
[*]Damage
[*]Fuel
[*]Food Value
[*]Durability
[*]Chest/Item/Bundle Highlighting
[*]Item/Cookbook Lookups
[*]Naughtiness
[*][u][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url] Integration[/u] (for [u]Naughtiness[/u] and corrected moon cycles)
[*]Follower Info
[*][i]Most things, really.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h3]Is this a server mod? Can you make a client mod version of this?[/h3]
[b][i][u]This is a server mod[/u][/i][/b].
A client-side version of this mod would have almost none of the information this mod displays. The server contains almost everything. That's why this is a server mod.

[h3]How do I turn <thing> off?[/h3]
Pretty much everything can be configured to turn on, off, or adjust the level of detail. If you can't find a configuration option from the main menu, you can double check the in-game configuration menu (Insight Menu -> Config Button).

[h3]There's too much information! I'm overwhelmed![/h3]
I've gotten feedback that the amount of information Insight provides can be overwhelming, or that it's too much effort to adjust all the configs. Insight now comes with some presets to adjust configurations in bulk:
[list]
[*][u]New Player[/u] - Recommended for new players, configured for a tiny amount of information to allow them the "authentic vanilla" experience.
[*][u]Simple[/u] - Recommended for players who liked Show Me's limited amount of information.
[*][u]Decent[/u] - More or less the default configuration layout with a few tweaks.
[*][u]Advanced[/u] - Recommended for players who like having a lot of information available.
[/list]
You can access these presets by going to the in-game Insight Menu -> Configure Mod -> Presets. Detected first-time users will be prompted to select a preset when first playing with Insight.

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
Feel free to suggest features or provide feedback, good or bad. This mod is still being developed, so it's possible for issues to occur. If you do encounter one, please check the bug reporting discussion post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2189004162/2793873675751084957/]here.[/url]
[b]You can also enable the automatic crash reporter, which will try to report your crashes for you.[/b]
Also, check out [url=https://support.klei.com/hc/en-us/articles/360029881191-Logs-and-Useful-Information-for-Bug-Reports-for-Don-t-Starve-Together]this link from Klei[/url] for advice on finding logs & submitting bugs.

[h1]Thank you's[/h1]
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Zarklord]Zarklord[/url] for helping me figure some stuff out.
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/rezecib]rezecib[/url] for helping me implement naughtiness for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=376333686]Combined Status[/url] and providing feedback on Insight's support for altered moon cycles.
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198870384878]licet_insanire[/url] for beta testing.
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198319567131/]Maxwell[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/cloudyyoung]Cloudy Young[/url], and 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/interesting28]虚の刃#28[/url] for doing the translations to Chinese.
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/senhoritabuss]Senorita Buss[/url] for doing the translations to Portuguese.
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Dislekzi4/]Diegowo[/url] for doing the translations to Spanish.
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/lehasex/]Лёха Секс[/url] for doing the translations to Russian.
A big thank you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199503229520]Seraf[/url] for doing the translations to Korean.

[h1]Source Code[/h1]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/penguin0616/insight]here.[/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: Farming Extension
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Adds more to farming! It's mostly to add more depth to the farming in DST.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]Features[/h1]

[b]Seemingly Harmless Plant Patches! [/b]

Pumpkins, asparagus, potatoes, garlic, onion, pomegranate (and technically dragonfruit*) are now to be found in the world and can no longer be grown from the plain seeds.

These patches can be a boon but they might not be quite as nice they seem! 

*Dragonfruit does not have a patch, you just cannot grow them from regular seeds and have to find them on the lunar island.

[i]Forest patches [/i]
-- Pumpkin

[i]Cave patches [/i] (See Harvest Spirit for details on non-cave servers)
-- Pomegranate
-- Onion
-- Garlic
-- Potato

[i]Both [/i]
-- Asparagus (fun fact, asparagus is a swamp grass so try to guess where to find it)

[b]Persephone's Cruse [/b]

Beware of eating any pomegranates you find in the caves before cleansing them of any evil curses! Eating the cursed fruit will trap you in the caves for 3 days and make anything near you hostile towards you (this latter part is true even just holding it)!

Try a lunar water source to purify the fruit first. (Moondials at night; lunar hot springs that have been bath bombed).
 
Magicpowder works on the fruit AND can remove it from players too.

Wortox's souls negate the curse both on the fruit and on any cursed players too but will cost 20 HP.

[b]Revamped Farming [/b] The regular farms can be turned off (off by default)

You now can till some of the various turfs to plant seeds. Different crops grow faster on different turfs. Using a pitchfork on a plant's tile will kill it though so no moving turf after you plant something! All crops grow best on fertile soil turf.

The crops also now have quality values (poop means bad and gold star means good). Quality reduces over time, usually. The crops will sometimes spawn files or weeds near them and these will reduce the crop's quality even faster.

You can use a straw hat to tend to the crop plant once a day to reduce the chance of lies (or get rid of them if they are there) and you can fertilise them to try to increase their quality. Good quality crops have a 20% chance of giving a second crop. Wormwood doesn't need a straw hat to tend to crops and will gain sanity from tending them.

Plants left unattended for too long will wilt, even if they fully grown!

You need to use ice on the new crops (quagmire ones) during Summer since I could not make the fling-o-matic protect them.

[u]Good quality[/u] crops give +35% of food values (or a reduction in negative ones) and last 35% longer.
[u]Bad quality[/u] crops give -30% of food values (or an increase in negative ones) and perish 30% sooner.

Crop quality does not affect cooking recipes (might change that in future)

[b]Mealingstone and Stone Oven [/b]

There is now a mealingstone with its own set of products like flour. Mushroom spore pack needs to be used on a stump.

There is also now a stone oven which does take some of the cookpot recipes (anything that would be baked is now to be made in the oven and not a cookpot). It also takes longer to bake things; can't rush a good roast!

** Recipes are changed to use more realistic ingredients **

[b]Harvest Spirit[/b]

The spirit of spring herself! She spawns every Spring on an island off the coast (sometimes of the coast of the lunar island not just the mainland). Give her offerings (she only accepts crops, preferably nice ones) and she might give you a gift every so often or she may destroy some structures near you if she is not kept happy. You can tell if she is happy based on the size of the flame above her head. If it is out, then she is not happy.

Her gifts are the only way to get certain crops (technically their seeds) if you are not playing with caves.

You can also choose to fight her by offering either a curse pomegranate or wheat (rejecting her wheat gift is disrespectful to her!). If you run away or die, she will leave until next Spring. You will get a random gift pouch when she dies and many emerald feathers.

The two new crafts she offers:

-- Cloud caller staff: summon a cloud pet (uses your pet slot sadly) that can be a nice inventory OR can heavy lift for you. You also float around on a cloud when equipped and increase your speed (without triggering spider webs too).

-- Harvest Gem staff: shoots projectiles, gives off light and can summon a small blast spell on some enemies.

Both staffs last 5 days and can be refuelled by emerald feathers or magic powder.

~ All assets belong to Klei, the harvest spirit is actually an unused asset from Hamlet.

publishedfiledetails.title: FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST EDWARD ELRIC  ver3.2h 2023: The King of Farming & Building
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Default language is Chinese, but you can change language to ENGLISH in mod configure![/h1]

[h1]With Edward mod on，though other player can use Edward's craft too, but only Edward can get side products when crafting. [/h1]

[h1]This mod published much earlier than new Wilson,and has better and larger number of alchemy than Wilson. A big difference is ,Edward's alchemy followed the rule of Equivalent exchange, so usually you will get by-product when using alchemy.[/h1]

[b]Now Edward has definitely become the KING of this new version of DST. Be tired of farming in this version? Just subscribe Edward and enjoy your new farming life!! [/b]

[h1]In VER 3.0,I also add 6 music of Fullmetal Alchemist to the game. 4 music for each time you enter the new season,and one for each time you enter the game. AND THE LAST BUT NOT THE LEAST, a perfect music for death!  [/h1]

[b]THE ONLY PS: I added the recipe of refresh hambat, but *When you trying to refresh a hambat, don't use skin !!!!
It will casue crash.IF you really need skin, rebuild one or use the magic broom.[/b]

[h1]The together version of Edward is the completed Edward[/h1]
To a certain extent, Edward could use his special skills to replace some ability of Wickerbottom and Woody. He is extremely capable in both fighting and building bases. For example, the special walls he could create can instantly divide the battlefield. By double-click on the stone wall, the damage it could take increases. Try utilizing this ability to kill dragonflies and build a home quickly!
(Only row of walls are high walls, and the others are low walls (convenient to build a home)

[h1]Preface:[/h1]
For the first time in my life, I dedicated my time to the eternal god "Fullmetal Alchemist". How can there be no Edward in the DST world, and how can there be no alchemy?

[h1]Creator List:[/h1]
Design, drawing, sound effects, Animation,balance and adjustment: Xiche
Code: Wulmaw (Ahao) (fast programming, high efficiency, neat code, rich experience. It is strongly recommended to find a partner or place an order with him during programming.)
English description editor : Cheshire Cat

[h1]Stats:[/h1]
Hunger: 150
Sanity: 160
Health: 130
Hunger speed: 1.0
Tough will: Sanity falling speed 0.8; Sanity rising speed 1.2
Quick Move: walking speed 4.5; running speed 7.2
Melee Mage: Damage modifier 1.25x
The Gate of Truth: Edward, who has passed through the Gate of Truth, was imbued with a lot of knowledge. He can read and write books and he is able to craft items from science station at the beginning of the game. He can practice alchemy without the transmutation cycle.
Steel body: Edward's right arm and left calf are made of steel. Since Wendy is not there, he must pay special attention to the maintenance issue. When it rains, Edward will constantly lose blood and move slower than usual if  humidity more than 10.
Special animation:
In the game, the crafting animation was replaced by Edward clapping animation since he does not need the transmutation cycle (hereinafter referred to as Polaroid).
In addition, when the player holds a hammer to hit the building, the animation is also Polaroid.

[h1]Active skills:[/h1]
(You can edit the keys in the configuration interface or disable them)
1.Instant Wall: (replacing the texture of the stone wall with the texture of the thulium wall, however, the material used is still rocks)

Row of wall (near): (a row of stone walls can be generated at a point near in front)
          consumes 18 rocks, 10 hunger, and 5 sanity. (high wall) shortcut key J
Row of wall (far): (a row of stone walls can be generated at a point further away from character)
          consumes 18 rocks, 10 hunger, and 5 sanity. (high wall) shortcut key U
Small square wall: (Stone walls can be generated around the character for protection)
          consumes 16 rocks, 8 hunger and 5 sanity. (low wall) shortcut key K
Super square wall: (Quickly build a small base or enclose enemies/friends) 
          consumes 64 rocks, 15 hunger and 10 sanity. (low wall) shortcut key I
Square prison (near): (An array of wall can be generated near the monster to enclose them) 
          consumes 20 rocks, 10 hunger and 5 sanity. (Low wall) shortcut key L
Square prison (far): (An array of wall can be generated in a further position to enclose monsters) 
          consumes 20 rocks, 10 hunger and 5 sanity. (low wall) shortcut key O

[h1]Tips: The walls can be stacked in the same position by clicking on them slowly. By doing so, the maximum damage they could take increase. You could also try high-speed double-clicking To see what would happen :)[/h1]

2. 
Analysis, decomposition but no reconstruction: consumes 6 hunger and 5 sanity, 3s CD, Shortcut key N
Alchemy is divided into three steps: analysis, decomposition, and reconstruction. If you only do the decomposition step, you can decompose and destroy the buildings in a certain area in front.
Edward learnt this from Scar's destruction. In addition to destruction, it can also generate 50 AOE damage. 
Edward is not a strong character in animation. His success was mostly due to the tough personality and the dignity of a melee mage.
In battle, skills are just assistances, you would still need to use your basic understanding of the game.  

[h1]Alchemy Craft Bar[/h1]
"Humankind cannot gain anything without first giving something in return. To obtain, something of equal value must be lost. That is alchemy's first law of Equivalent Exchange. In those days, we really believed that to be the world's one, and only truth.” --Alphonse Elric

[b]"Equivalent Exchange"[/b]
Since alchemy’s basic rule is equivalently exchange, when designing the formula list, the chemical formula of each object was referred to and finally a total of 80 unique alchemy formulas in the current version were drafted.

Ps:! ! Most of alchemy has by-products. This is the real equivalent exchange. Only by using by-products well can you become an accomplished alchemist---! !

[b]"Forbidden Alchemy"[/b]
Every time when the player is crafting high-value or rare items, some sanity or hp or hunger will be consumed. 

[b]"Chimera Alchemy"[/b]  (new!!!)
2Months has been past since Edward was crossed over to Klei’s World. Finally he figure out how to make chimera in this world. Though it was an evil alchemy in Edward’s world.But in Klei’s World, the rule of alchemy is different:Chimera Alchemy doesn’t need human body to make it come true. 
3.0 NEW:1 more chimera, and now you can get all kinds of seeds if you make all kinds of chimera.The by products of each of them will have 1 or more kinds of seeds.

[b]"Human Transmutation"[/b]
This is equivalent to a meat effigy. It consumes not only materials but also a lot of sanity and 20 health. Future versions will add complete body formations and animations.

[b]"Remote Alchemy"[/b]
Now Edward can remotely build buildings，use mostl kind of tools and put down dogteeth traps within a certain range (you know what I mean? Funny). 
3.0 new:remote plant ,remote farm, remote push water, remote till, remote fertilizer ,remote fill  !!Now you are the king of the new version of DST!

Tips for playing:
The walls made at this stage will fall to the ground after being decomposed, and you can only pick them up one by one if you want to reuse them. In the later stage, the lazy talisman can greatly improve Edward's combat effectiveness (the lazy talisman is epic-enhanced). You can also try using Auto stack and pick mod.
Version number: 3.2h

Check the Update log to see the detail of every update. 

Future update:
If I am rich enough, I will try to make the whole world of Fullmetal Alchemist.

publishedfiledetails.title: Advanced Farming [Fork]
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][b]END OF DEVELOPMENT AND GOODBYE[/b][/h1]
I have stopped the development of this and future mods. 
More information can be found on the link below. 
[url=data.ewul.net/dlc/Game/DST/goodbye.html]Goodbye[/url].

[h1][b]MAIN FEATURES:[/b][/h1]
Enables the player to craft Advanced Farm which grows crop faster and even during winter and Hybrid Banana Tree which grows Hybrid Bananas that provide beneficial stats to the player when eaten.
You can configure the Advanced Farm recipe.
You can disable the Hybrid Banana seeds if you don't want them.
You can set the Hybrid Banana Trees to bear fruit or not in the winter.

[b]Advanced Farm[/b]
Craftable under Food Tab.
Easy Recipe = 3 Boards, 3 Silk and 1 Rope. No Machine Required.
Normal Recipe = 3 Boards, 3 Silk , 2 Rope and 10 poop. Use a Science Machine.
Hard Recipe = 5 Boards, 6 Silk , 4 Rope and 10 poop. Use an Alchemy Engine.

[b]The Hybrid Banana Tree[/b]
Craftable under Refine Tab.
Recipe = 1 Carrot Seed and 1 Dragonfruit Seed. Use an Alchemy Engine.

[h1][b]FORKED MOD[/b][/h1]
This mod is forked and not originally made by me.
Original Mod Link: [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=370373189]DST Advanced Farming[/url] by [url=steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197989646930]Afro1967[/url]
The reason why this is forked is either due to the old mod being: 
	1) Broken. 
	2) Incompatible with some other mod. 
	3) The original author stopped updating his/her mod. 
	4) The original author allowed to modify the mod to add/remove some additions to it.
Full credit goes to the original author of the mod.
If requested by the original author, this mod will be taken down from workshop.

[h1][b]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b][/h1]
Since this is forked mod, not many additions will be added to it, only focus is on bugfixes.
The mod is backwards compatible with the original mod, meaning it can be replaced on live server and everything continues to work correctly.

[h1][b]BUG REPORTING:[/b][/h1]
Add all your bug reports under "Discussions" > "Bug Reports". (To avoid Comment section cluttering)
Also a great help is if you can upload your crash log "log.txt" to [url=pastebin.com/]PasteBin[/url] and link me the crash log that way in the bug section with a description what did you do before the crash occured.

[h1][b]LIVE CHAT:[/b][/h1]
If you wish to talk to Me or other players or users of this Mod, you can join us on Live chat where we can discuss problems, ask questions or simply chat about random things.
Join here and proceed to "Gaming" room: [url=im.ewul.net/public/]EWUL Public Chat[/url]
